Ayurvedic treatment used in mania, loss of concentration or memory, epilepsy, anxiety, psychosis, irritability, depression.

sections.contraindications_side_effects:
Self-medication with this medicine is strictly not recommended, have it only under strict medical direction. 
 Consume this powder in fixed doses and for a limited period of time, as guided by the doctor.

 Overdose may result in gastritis. 
 Keep it out of reach and sight of children.

fullContent:
Saraswata Churna 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali Unmada Roga Chikitsa 26 – 29 
 Introduction 
 Saraswata Churna is a classical herbal powder that maintains the balances of Vata and Pitta Dosha. Ayurvedic medicine is useful in treatment of psychosis, depression, low intelligence level etc. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kushta ( Saussurea lappa) 
 Ashwagandha ( Withania somnifera ) 
 Saindhava (Rock Salt) 
 Ajamoda  ( Trachyspermum ammi) 
 Cumin seed ( Cuminum cyminum ) 
 Krishna Jeeraka ( Nigella sativa ) 
 Dry ginger ( Zingiber officinalis ) 
 Black pepper ( Piper nigrum ) 
 Pippali ( Piper longum ) 
 Patha ( Cyclea peltata ) 
 Vacha ( Acorus calamus ) 
 Shankhapushpi ( Convolvulus pluricaulis ) 
 Juice extract of Brahmi ( Bacopa monnieri ) whole plant 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 First 12 Ingredients are powdered separately and then mixed together in a definite quantity. Then grind it along with brahmi juice three times, dry it under the shade. Keep it in a dry place and store in an airtight container. 
 Dosage 
 Consume ½-1 grams along with ghee and honey 1-2 times a day before or after meals or as suggested by the doctor. 
 It is generally recommended to have it during early morning on an empty stomach. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 Ayurvedic treatment used in mania, loss of concentration or memory, epilepsy, anxiety, psychosis, irritability, depression. 
Also good use in disorders of speech and anemia etc. 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 
 Self-medication with this medicine is strictly not recommended, have it only under strict medical direction. 
 Consume this powder in fixed doses and for a limited period of time, as guided by the doctor. 
 Diabetic, hypertensive patients, cardiac patients, obese people, pregnant ladies, lactating mothers and children should take this medicine strictly under medical supervision. 
 Overdose may result in gastritis. 
 Keep it out of reach and sight of children. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
